longForm.heroLead: Up to six times a rotary evaporator's throughput. One machine instead of several. A rotary evaporator processes one flask at a time. Rocket Synergy 2 was built to stop that from being the bottleneck. It runs up to six times the throughput of a rotary evaporator, with genuine walkaway automation, low-pressure steam heating, and auto-draining built in. One compact unit takes the place of several separate evaporators on the bench. Dri-Pure anti-bumping technology eliminates foaming, bumping, and cross-contamination between samples. Flip-Flop and SampleGenie let you concentrate or dry directly in storage or autosampler vials, so nothing needs transferring afterward, and recovery stays consistent sample to sample.

sections.title: Genevac Rocket Synergy 2 at a Glance
sections.description: Everything you need to evaluate the Rocket Synergy 2: how it outpaces a rotary evaporator, what steam heating and direct-vial concentration actually deliver, which sample formats and applications it fits, and Inkarp installation and service support.
sections.subheading: Up to six times a rotary evaporator's throughput. One machine instead of several.
body: The comparison point is a rotary evaporator, and the number is real. Up to six times the throughput, not a vague efficiency claim.
One unit replaces several. Compact design consolidates what would otherwise be multiple separate evaporators taking up bench space.
Steam heating is a genuinely different mechanism. Low-pressure steam maximizes drying efficiency, with chamber design specifically built to keep moisture out of the sample.
Sample protection covers three failure modes, not one. Dri-Pure anti-bumping technology addresses foaming, bumping, and cross-contamination together.
Direct-vial concentration removes a whole transfer step. Flip-Flop and SampleGenie let samples concentrate or dry directly in storage or autosampler vials.
Capacity spans small format to large batch. Six 450 mL flasks, 18 ASE vials, or large-volume batches up to 5 L.
The chiller is optional, and it's controlled, not just connected. A recirculating chiller is available, run through the Rocket Synergy 2 itself via RS232.

sections.title: Steam Heating and Sample Recovery
body: Two things usually cost you time and sample after evaporation: waiting for a slow heating method, and transferring the concentrated sample somewhere else afterward. Rocket Synergy 2 addresses both directly.

Low-pressure steam heating maximizes drying efficiency, and the chamber design is specifically built to keep moisture from reaching the sample during the process. On the recovery side, Flip-Flop and SampleGenie let concentration or drying happen directly in the storage or autosampler vial the sample is going to live in anyway, which is what actually improves recovery and keeps results consistent from one sample to the next, rather than losing material in a transfer step.
